AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to AB 361 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's recommended measures to promote social distancing. All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed; however, the meeting will be recorded and made available on the City's website. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83056202386
Zoom Meeting ID: 830 5620 2386
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 830 5620 2386#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Please submit your correspondence in writing to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org. Comments received by NOON on Thursday NOVEMBER 18, 2021 will be included with the posted agenda. Additional comments received by NOON on Tuesday, November 23, 2021 will be forwarded to the Councilmembers and posted online as late correspondence. All correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to participate under COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC or on any item of interest on the Agenda by simply utilizing the "Raise Hand" feature during the item under consideration. When called upon to speak please state your name for the record. Members of the public are not required to submit notification in advance.
Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on the City's website under City Council Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL

This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1-8)
1.
CITY COUNCIL ACTION MINUTES
a)
Minutes of November 9, 2021 Regular Meeting
b)
Minutes of November 9, 2021 Special Meeting
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
Minutes
2.
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTERS
Recommendation:   Review and Approve Warrant Register(s) of November 23, 2021
Warrants
3.
REAFFIRMING THE FINDINGS TO HOLD VIRTUAL CITY COUNCIL, COMMISSION, COMMITTEE, BOARD AND OTHER CITY BODIES, MEETINGS UNDER AB 361
Recommendation: That the City Council reaffirm the findings set forth in Resolution No. R21-38 to continue to hold virtual meetings pursuant to AB 361.
Staff Report
4.
RECEIPT AND FILING OF FINANCIAL STATEMENTS FOR THE PERIOD ENDING OCTOBER 31, 2021
Recommendation: That the City Council receive and file financial statements for the month ending October 31, 2021.
Staff Report
5.
RECEIPT AND FILING OF THE MONTHLY INVESTMENT TRANSACTION REPORTS FOR THE MONTH ENDING OCTOBER 31, 2021
Recommendation: The City Treasurer recommends the City Council receive and file the Monthly Investment Transaction Reports for the month ending October 31, 2021.
Staff Report
Treasurer's Report CORRECTED
6.
ACCEPT THE PW-674-19 VIA CAMPESINA STREET IMPROVEMENTS PROJECT, AUTHORIZE THE CITY CLERK TO FILE THE NOTICE OF COMPLETION FOR THE PROJECT AND RELEASE RETENTION
Recommendation: that the City Council accept PW-674-19 Via Campesina Street Improvements Project, authorize the City Clerk to file the Notice of Completion for the project and release retention.
Staff Report
Revised Staff Report
7.
PLANNING COMMISSION ACTIONS OF NOVEMBER 16, 2021 Recommendation: That The City Council receive and file.
Staff Report
8.
AWARD OF PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT TO CSG CONSULTANTS, INC. FOR THE HOUSING ELEMENT AND SAFETY ELEMENT UPDATE PROJECT
Recommendation: That the City Council award a Professional Services Agreement to CSG Consultants, Inc. in the amount of $104,585.00 for the Housing Element and Safety Element updates to the General Plan.
Staff Report
PUBLIC HEARING(S)/ORDINANCES
OLD BUSINESS
9.
PROPOSED RESOLUTION TO: (1) AUTHORIZE THE RECRUITMENT OF A FULL-TIME PLANNER; (2) EXPAND THE CITY MANAGER?S AUTHORITY TO $100,000.00 FOR CONTRACT STAFF IN THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT FOR FISCAL YEAR 20-21; (3) MAKE A SUPPLEMENTAL APPROPRIATION FROM THE GENERAL FUND IN THE AMOUNT OF $55,232.29; AND (4) AUTHORIZE THE CITY SUPPORT SERVICES DIRECTOR TO MAKE SUCH ACCOUNTING ENTRIES FOR THIS SUPPLEMENTAL APPROPRATION AS DEEMED APPROPRIATE
Recommendation: That the City Council adopt the proposed resolution to: (1) authorize the recruitment of a full-time Planner; (2) expand the City Manager?s authority to $100,000.00 for contract staff in the Community Development Department for Fiscal Year 21-22; (3) make a supplemental appropriation in the General Fund in the amount of $55,232.29; and (4) authorize the City Support Services Director to make such accounting entries for this supplemental appropriation as deemed appropriate.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
10.
ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R21-___ APPROVING THE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING WITH THE PALOS VERDES ESTATES POLICE OFFICERS ASSOCIATION 7-1-2021 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2023
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt the proposed resolution approving the Memorandum of Understanding with the Palos Verdes Estates Police Officers Association from July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2021.
Revised Staff Report
Working Copy of MOU
11.
DISCUSSION OF SENIOR ACCOUNTANT RECRUITMENTS, POTENTIAL OPTIONS TO MITIGATE CITY CHALLENGES, AND RECOMMENDATIONS FOR THIS POSITION’S NEXT RECRUITMENT CYCLE
Recommendation: that the City Council discuss the issues highlighted and either provide guidance or approve recommended actions.
Staff Report
12.
FINAL YEAR-END ADMINISTRATIVE BUDGET ADJUSTMENT
Recommendation: That the City Council (a) approve and authorize the Director of City Support Services to make administrative budget adjustments that are greater than $10,000 to the FY 2020-21 amended budget as specified in Exhibit A of the Resolutions, and (b) receive and file administrative budget adjustments that are less than or equal to $10,000 to the FY 2020-21 amended budget as specified in Attachment B. MAYOR AND COUNCILMEMBER REPORTS
This portion of the agenda is reserved for the Mayor and Councilmembers to provide comments, report on community activities and ad hoc committees, and propose topics to be calendared on a future Council agenda.
Staff Report
